mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_member_otp (otp_id, member_id, site_id, purpose, code_hash, expires_at, attempt_count, verified_at, client_ip, created_by, created_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{otpId}, #{memberId}, #{siteId}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0, NULL, #{clientIp}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, current_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT otp_id, member_id, site_id, purpose, code_hash, expires_at, attempt_count, verified_at, client_ip, created_by, created_ip, created_at FROM tb_member_otp WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND verified_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, otp_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_member_otp SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp() WHERE otp_id = #{otpId}
UPDATE tb_member_otp SET verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp() WHERE otp_id = #{otpId} AND verified_at IS NULL
